visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hands are seen adjusting three small, bright green motorized racing cars (Mini 4WD) inside a white plastic starting block divided into three lanes. The background is a grey concrete floor in a large indoor warehouse-style space with bright overhead lighting. (2) A close-up view shows the intricate mechanical details of the cars, which feature carbon fiber plates, small yellow rollers, and neon green chassis. The person repeatedly lifts and repositions the cars, ensuring they are properly seated against the starting gate. (3) The front gate of the starting block drops suddenly, and the three cars accelerate with high velocity into a multi-lane white track that features sharp turns marked with blue, yellow, and red colors. (4) The camera follows the cars as they navigate complex track elements, including high-speed curves and elevation changes. In the background, a white van and various storage items are visible in the dimly lit warehouse area. (5) The cars continue racing around the track for multiple laps, with the camera panning and tilting to maintain visual contact. Finally, the person reaches down to the end of the lane to catch the lead car as it arrives at the finish line.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with several distinct, high-pitched mechanical clicks as the speaker prepares the environment. A male voice speaks in Mandarin with a calm but focused tone. There is no background music. (2) A sharp, high-frequency electric motor whirring sound starts abruptly as the first car is activated. The sound is consistent and intense. (3) Additional mechanical clicks follow as the second and third cars are turned on, creating a layered high-frequency buzzing sound that dominates the audio track. (4) A loud, percussive plastic thud signals the release of the cars. The buzzing intensity shifts as the cars accelerate. The male speaker begins counting rhythmically in Mandarin. (5) The audio is filled with the continuous high-pitched whirring of motors and the sharp clattering of plastic cars hitting the walls of the track. The speaker provides enthusiastic commentary on the lap times. (6) A final loud plastic impact and a muffled thud are heard as the lead car is caught, followed by the sound of the motor whirring coming to a stop.
